keyDates.text: ED Office for Civil Rights launched investigations into five medical schools, including Dartmouth Geisel, for alleged racial discrimination in admissions.
Yale and 35 other universities filed amicus brief in First Circuit supporting Harvard's $2.7B federal funding freeze lawsuit.
Pentagon named UNC-Chapel Hill and Virginia Tech as first new Senior Service College Fellowship hosts, replacing cut Ivy League programs.
Brown University to sponsor full WaterFire lighting in Providence honoring first responders after the December 13, 2025 campus shooting.
DHS final rule ending F-1/J-1 'Duration of Status' takes effect, capping international student stays at four years. Affects ~1.2M current students.
First Circuit Court of Appeals expected to hear oral arguments in Harvard v. HHS federal funding freeze case.
Columbia's SAT/ACT requirement takes effect for Class of 2032 applicants. All eight Ivies will then require standardized testing.
FY2026 government funding deadline. Congress must act or risk shutdown; higher ed appropriations for FY2027 remain unresolved.

charts.title: Pentagon Senior Service College Fellowships Canceled by Institution (2026-27)
charts.footnote: Data from Hegseth's Feb. 2026 memorandum listing 93 fellowships canceled across 22 universities and organizations for the 2026-27 academic year.

charts.title: OBBBA Endowment Excise Tax Tiers for Private Universities (Eff. Jan. 1, 2026)
charts.footnote: Tax applies only to private universities with 3,000+ tuition-paying students and endowment assets exceeding $500,000 per student. Public universities are exempt.

charts.title: F-1 Visa Policy: Key Timeline Under DHS Final Rule (Effective Sept. 15, 2026)
charts.footnote: Grace period cut applies to post-completion departure window only. The 30-day arrival window does not count against the 4-year maximum. Students who leave and re-enter the U.S. on or after Sept. 15 are admitted under new fixed-period rules.
